youtube.title: What If You Aged Backwards and Couldn't Stop?
youtube.intro: One morning you wake up a year younger. The next morning, another year. Fifteen days later you'd be a newborn, and nobody knows how to stop it. The first days are fun. Then the catch arrives, and someone in a black car starts paying attention.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Stay home for the last week, or go to the lab? 👇 What would you do, and why?

And what do you think is happening to Ellie? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The science checks out: kids really grow about 2 inches a year, babies are born with about 300 bones, and most people's earliest memory is from around age 3. Sources are in the description.
